This declaration contains independently reviewed source identities, literal original membership and physical boundaries, never candidate quantities. Six unit-multiplier Zones include return PLENUM with actual positive heating and cooling but no conditioned service ownership. Original Zone Air System Sensible H/C includes non-air baseboard LoadMet and remains the aggregate load authority; native baseboard Total Heating is non-additive, not generated heat or a fuel-specific load partition. Native electricity is model-total once, even when aggregate Zone loads require multipliers. Only SPACE2/4 own native electric baseboards; their ten exact radiation recipients remain mixed HVAC/environment surface response, not passive-only drivers or excluded radiant emitters. Surface Energy/J before Rate/W, sign -1; the original 40 building surfaces plus six fenestration surfaces provide 46 heat-transfer observations; two shading geometries provide no convection source. Internal people/lights/equipment and infiltration exist in five SPACE Zones; total internal/balance and sensible load observations exist in all six. Gross infiltration signs remain separate, outdoor remainder subtracts infiltration only within matching Zone/month; PLENUM has its own unsplit outdoor observation. Central natural-gas boiler serves five Zones through the main heating air coil and three local reheat coils; local electric heaters do not exclude SPACE2/4 from central service. Broad Heating:Electricity has exactly two native baseboard inputs plus boiler ancillary electricity; direct source budgets and shared-boiler budget are independently allocated without assigning unknown broad remainder. Boiler ancillary zero is required to be observed, never inferred from omitted parasitic input. Broad mixed heating ratios are load_to_site_energy, not equipment COP or combustion efficiency. Cooling uses central chiller service to five Zones; return PLENUM is not a sixth owner. Pumps include hot/chilled/condenser loops without measured constituent consumption, so the mixed meter is unassigned. HeatRejection is one broad meter with one original MTD tower-fan constituent and a five-Zone condenser cooling-load-share estimate; no native Cooling Tower Electricity E/R observation is claimed. All eight SQL arithmetic and complete-record coverage groups must pass independently before this draft is accepted. The sole original Fan:VariableVolume Supply Fan 1 belongs to the one VAV Sys 1 main branch and five exact splitter/terminal/ADU/EquipmentConnections owners. Fans:Electricity is a broad actual meter allocated by cooling-plus-heating load share, not a native fan measurement or airflow-based share. Every original SQL observation is preserved: 222871 old ReportData rows match the new SQL without changed, missing or duplicate observations; annualization and the 8772-row weather time axis are unchanged. Added outputs do not imply warning-free execution: the new run has 23 warnings and zero Severe/Fatal errors. Approval remains pending.
